Name: Jekk's Ostrich Reskin
Author: jekkbenavu
Description:
[size=5][i][u]Installation![/u][/i]﻿[/size]
﻿It's real easy to install, you can download and add it just like any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod. Or you can take the pngs and use them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt N Skin[/url]. Personally [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt N Skin[/url] is my preferred method, entirely up to you though! Also, If you'd like to see more reskins from me I'd be super happy to come up with some more. I'm constantly making Skins for my own gameplay. I'm happy to improve others as well. Aesthetic in a game is lovely, as an artist I simply stand by that. Feel free to leave me some feedback, I'm happy to hear it.
[i][u]Also just a side note:[/u]
[size=3]I do this for fun. If there's bugs or issues I need to fix let me know. I'm quite new to coding, I just like doing art, so.. don't be too harsh; constructive criticism is appreciated though.[/size][/i][size=3] 
[/size]Thank you for reading if you did! I truly hope you have an easy time using my mod

Downloads.Description: Time to start your fun ostrich adventure!
